wren.name: Wren

outfit.name: Red-Ochre Split Cape and First Tally

wren.notes: An off-centre red top-knot, waist-long cord tails and flared split shoulder hide keep her upper silhouette overwhelmingly red, while the absurdly large tally tucked under her left arm announces that she is already keeping score.

ash.name: Ash the hunter

outfit.name: Layered Winter Hides and Crooked Hunter's Staff

ash.notes: His tall, narrow grey silhouette now has overlapping angled hides with unequal hems, a diagonal bound seam, pale fur collar and dark waist belt, while the oversized bandage knot and grinning staff tip remain.

moss.name: Old Moss

prop.name: Wide Weathered Root Stump with Pale Growth-Ring Seat at 0.42

moss.notes: Her unchanged low green shawl, covered knees and comically oversized single Folly-knot sit above a broad pale stump rim, with dark roots spreading beside her feet to distinguish the seat from the dirt.

oak.name: Oak the builder

outfit.name: Tapered Orange Hide Apron and Hanging Stone Mallet

oak.notes: Orange-dyed shoulder and back hides make his broad builder silhouette orange from every direction, while the tapered apron, dark ties and belt, knee-hanging stone mallet and absurdly tiny spare mallet remain unchanged.

kit.name: Kit

outfit.name: Blue Overlap Wrap and Little Chief's Stick

kit.notes: Small, hatless and blue, he wears an offset-tied hide wrap above bare shins and uneven boots, with a high-hanging gold badge and a proudly upright, comically stubby copy of the Chief's staff.

head.name: Chief

outfit.name: Chief's Close-Fitted Sash of Excessive Importance

head.notes: His unchanged full-size antlers rise above a body-hugging gold sash running from left shoulder to right hip, where an unnecessarily grand gold knot and short tail advertise his vanity without projecting past his sides.
